newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.

text.p: * Tension remains high among protesting Jiu Valley miners. Thousands of miners continued their protests in Petrosani, awaiting the decisions of a strike committee.
* On Friday, miners will decide how they will fight for their demands.
* The army will not take action against miners, but might intervene if the country's stability will be put in danger, Defence Minister Victor Babiuc told a news conference.
* Miners from other regions on Thursday announced their support for the Jiu Valley strikers.
